text: After her estranged mother's death, Linda Stevens [inherits Montclare|origin|family blood and inheritance], a rambling rural estate that houses a rest home for the elderly. Soon after she arrives, on the same night as the aged new boarder Mrs. Ryan, a resident is found [drowned in a bathtub|images|water and drowning]. Her mother's old diaries speak of being watched, records surface for an aunt Rita supposedly long dead, and Linda comes to fear that [someone is stalking the house|threat|people who kill] and preying on [the elderly residents|who_suffers|the old, sick and dying].
